zh: 从“抠得干净”到“真的可用”：一次图像模型评测实践
en: From clean cutouts to usable results: evaluating image models

excerpts.zh: 先定义用户想得到什么，再决定如何评价模型。
excerpts.en: Define what users want before deciding how to evaluate a model.

excerpts.zh: 产品规则不清与模型能力不足需要分开处理。
excerpts.en: Unclear product rules and model limitations need to be addressed separately.

excerpts.zh: 诊断样本适合发现问题，但不能直接代表线上分布。
excerpts.en: Diagnostic samples reveal problems but do not directly represent the production distribution.

excerpts.zh: 自动指标与人工评审共同支持对产品可用性的判断。
excerpts.en: Automatic metrics and human review jointly inform judgments about product usability.

excerpts.zh: 参考标注和样本归组争议需要先于模型输赢结论解决。
excerpts.en: Disputes about reference annotations and sample assignments need resolving before declaring a model winner.

excerpts.zh: 实验环境中的耗时不能替代端侧真机性能测试。
excerpts.en: Experimental runtimes do not substitute for on-device performance testing.
